
## Fixes

- Restore focus inside the current section after actions instead of unexpectedly opening the main menu.
- Restore catalogue focus after closing quick actions or changing watchlist/progress.
- Keep one native trailer video surface during inline-to-fullscreen expansion, without restarting playback.

## Lower-transfer cloud sync

- Check cloud revisions before downloading account data; reuse encrypted local caches.
- Upload only changed progress, preferences/settings and image components, with compression before encryption.
- Refresh resume progress without downloading unrelated images/settings.
- Show local cloud-transfer totals in App Diagnostics.
- Production Neon incremental-sync migration is applied; existing encrypted snapshots are preserved.

**Update every TV using the same account to this version before using cloud sync. Once that account saves in the new format, older versions cannot restore it. Do not downgrade afterward.**

Signed 32-bit Android TV build. Local unit tests and release lint/build are validated; physical-TV focus/trailer and multi-device sync validation is still required.
